{{Top|canon=4-A7}} {{Droid |type=CIS |image=[[File:4A-7.jpg]] |name=4A-7 |homeworld=[[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' |birth= |death=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] |creator= |manufacturer=[[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] |line= |model=Early [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] prototype |class=[[Espionage droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' |mass= |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Masculine programming]] |pronouns=He/him[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] |sensor= |plating= |armament=[[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#13: 4A-7|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW13_4A7.asp}} |equipment= |affiliation=[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] }} {{Quote|If you truly believe that the Republic and the Jedi Order are wholly good, and that the Confederacy is wholly evil, then you're even more dangerous than my mistress thinks.|4A-7, shortly before being beheaded by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|}} '''4A-7''' was an early [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] prototype manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] had the body of a [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] and an over-sized head containing surveillance equipment. ==Biography== {{Quote|The droids have done their part. Now it's your turn. Be ''convincing."
"''That's my programming, ma'am.|Asajj Ventress and 4A-7|}} [[File:Ventress_4A7.png|thumb|left|250px|4A-7 with its mistress, Asajj Ventress, on Teth.]] 4A-7 was stationed at the [[B'omarr Monastery]] on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], alongside [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who considered the droid her only friend. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] arrived at the monastery, 4A-7 claimed he was the caretaker of the structure, and tried to make the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] believe he was grateful. After a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] recorded Skywalker and Tano rescuing [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]], 4A-7 doctored the image so that it made it seem like the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were kidnapping the baby and planning [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] assassination. This recording was shown to Jabba by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[File:4A-7_uncovered.png|thumb|right|250px|4A-7's treachery is discovered.]] When the two Jedi, Rotta, and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were preparing to flee Teth aboard the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], 4A-7 appeared at the boarding ramp of the ship. He was [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] by Tano after he was discovered to be in league with the Confederacy. The droid was brought back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by Ahsoka so information could be retrieved from its [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]]. A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] was tasked with [[Slicer/Legends|cracking]] the droid.{{TCWA|Droid Programming}} ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{C|as "4-A7"}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Clone Wars (audiobook)}} {{1st|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]]}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] {{1st|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]]}} *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of 4A-7}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{SWPM|set=Clone Wars|cardname=4A-7|link=http://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/89197/cid/6418381/2008-Star-Wars-Pocketmodel-TCG-Clone-Wars-81-4A-7}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' {{Po}} *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#13: 4A-7|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW13_4A7.asp}} *{{InsiderCite|112|The Voice Will Be With You, Always|The ''Voice'' Will Be With You, Always}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *{{DB|character|rotta|Rotta the Hutt}} {{Imo}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.25|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.25]] *{{FactFile2014|6|4A7 1-2|4A-7}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=4A-7 |hu=4A-7 |nl=4A-7 }} [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:RA-7 protocol droids]] [[Category:Spies]]
